# Datasheets (bob-929)

The **single shared datasheet library** for bob-929 (`Hardware/datasheets/`) — one place for every chip
and board we use, **not** per-board/topic dirs. Currently holds the parts on the bench BOM
([`../bench/BOM.md`](../bench/BOM.md)) plus the carrier/SoM docs. How we manage / where to find
datasheets: `.claude/skills/ucm-dev/references/datasheets.md`.

## Still to fetch (vendor bot-wall / needs browser)

- **nRF52840 chip** (silicon in the Seeed XIAO **and** the dongle) → save as `nrf52840_ps.pdf`. Browser:
  - Docs: https://docs.nordicsemi.com/bundle/ps_nrf52840/page/keyfeatures_html5.html
  - Direct PDF: https://docs-be.nordicsemi.com/bundle/ps_nrf52840/attach/nRF52840_PS_v1.8.pdf
  - Product page: https://www.nordicsemi.com/Products/nRF52840
- **nRF52840 Dongle board — PCA10059** (the dongle in use; board files: User Guide + schematic + PCB) →
  save as `nrf52840-dongle-pca10059.pdf` (+ hardware zip). Download page (JS/bot-walled → browser):
  - https://www.nordicsemi.com/Products/Development-hardware/nRF52840-Dongle/Download
- **nRF51822** (BBC micro:bit V1.3) → save as `nrf51822_ps.pdf`. Needs a browser:
  - Product page: https://www.nordicsemi.com/products/nrf51822
  - PDF: https://infocenter.nordicsemi.com/pdf/nRF51822_PS_v3.1.pdf
- **Board docs (vendor wikis — schematic/pinout, not always a clean PDF):**
  - Seeed XIAO nRF52840: https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/XIAO_BLE/
  - Arducam Pico4ML: https://docs.arducam.com/Raspberry-Pi-Pico/Pico4ml-Getting-Started/
  - BBC micro:bit V1: https://tech.microbit.org/hardware/schematic/ · https://tech.microbit.org/hardware/edgeconnector/
